description: Create an Airflow DAG for energy_grid that processes four market regions in parallel TaskGroups and then performs a serialized merge into a shared settlement table. Each region group runs extract >> transform >> stage in parallel with the other regions. The merge tasks for the four regions write to the same table and must run one at a time (pool with 1 slot), in any order, after their own region's stage task. A final 'settlement_totals' task runs after all four merges and checks that the sum of regional settled energy equals the grid-wide control total within 0.1%.
edge_cases: Merges must be serialized via a single-slot pool; chaining them linearly would make a failure in one region block the others
Each merge must delete only its own region and date before inserting
Interval readings are 15-minute energy values in kWh while the control total is in MWh; units must be converted before comparison
Tolerance check is relative: abs(sum - control) / control <= 0.001; a control total of 0 must be handled
If one region fails, settlement_totals must not run and the three successful regions remain loaded
common_failure_modes: FM6: Concurrent merges into the same table deadlock or interleave delete/insert
FM3: Unit mismatch (kWh vs MWh) makes the control check meaningless or always failing
FM3: Delete scoped by date only removes other regions' rows already merged
